Name: Tron Light
Description: This armor is imbued with colored light that can be activated for 1 action. Though it can reveal the wielder in darkness, it does not provide much more light than that.

Name: Simian
Description: Using Acrobatics to jump, swim, or climb costs -1 action (minimum of 1), and its distance is instead 1/2 the wielder's Acrobatics roll. (Upgrades continue adding 1/4 to distance)

Name: Graze
Description: When an attack misses the wielder by 5 or less points, this armor allows the wielder to move 1 space.

Name: Thorns
Description: This armor gives its wielder thorns that deal 1d4 damage (bypassing armor) to melee attackers.

Name: Resistance
Description: This armor gives its wielder +4 Will against magical attacks.

Name: Warding
Description: Negative magical effects on you last 1 less turn.

Name: Seasonal
Description: This armor provides its wielder immunity to the effects of climate.

Name: Storage
Description: You may contain up to 3 items within this armor that can be taken out for 1 action. These items must be smaller than the armor itself.

Name: Perfumed
Description: This armor grants its wielder +6 to all Persuasion rolls.

Name: Spellcatching
Description: If attacked by magic, this armor can store the spell used against the wielder to use when they choose. The original attack still has its effect, and the wielder’s spell can only be used once.

Name: Balance
Description: This armor prevents extra effects done to its wielder due to Race or alignment.

Name: Darkblessed
Description: This armor negates all effects (except base damage) from Stealth attacks.

Name: Hindering
Description: This armor limits attackers’ Move actions to 2 on their next turn.

Name: Swiftskin
Description: The wielder of this armor may sacrifice their HP for more speed. Every 2 HP sacrificed provides 1 Move action per turn.

Name: Hovering
Description: This armor can float on command, allowing its wielder to levitate at 1 space per action.

Name: Buffer
Description: This armor gives its wielder +6 Armor against Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage - damage type chosen upon enchantment.

Name: Coolant
Description: This armor takes ½ damage from fire and heat, and its wielder cannot be set aflame.

Name: Dominion
Description: Attacks against the wielder of this armor, successful or not, cause the attacker to lose -1 Will against Intimidation and mind control effects.

Name: Heated
Description: This armor takes ½ damage from frost and cold, and its wielder cannot be slowed from cold attacks.

Name: Insulated
Description: This armor takes ½ damage from lightning attacks, or 1/4 damage if wearing 8+ Armor.

Name: Oilslicked
Description: This armor grants its wielder +1 Move action per turn, +1 Reflex and Fortitude, and a ½ chance to escape traps. However, the wielder is always flammable.

Name: Autorepair
Description: This armor heals its wielder 1 HP each turn and repairs itself for 1 Armor every 2 turns.

Name: Blur
Description: This armor blurs its wielder. Any successful attack against them must immediately roll 1d10. On a 1 or 2, the attack misses.

Name: Tetra
Description: This armor takes half damage from fire, frost, lightning, or sonic attacks against its wielder.

Name: Lifesaving
Description: Upon any attack, the wielder of this armor can choose to negate all damage done to them. If so, this armor shatters beyond repair.

Name: Branding
Description: Leaves a permanent signature mark on targets hit.

Name: Resonant
Description: This weapon adds its wielder’s lowest Stat to its damage.

Name: Instrument
Description: This weapon can be used as a musical instrument of your choice.

Name: Elastic
Description: This melee weapon’s range is doubled.

Name: Splinterwound
Description: Attacks with this ranged weapon deal an extra 1 damage to the enemy each turn and reduces healing done to them by -1.

Name: Disguised
Description: The wielder of this weapon can make it look like an ordinary object at any time.

Name: Infinite Ammunition
Description: This ranged weapon will never run out of its required ammunition.

Name: Bloodhound
Description: Targets hit by this weapon can be tracked for the next 24 hours.

Name: Duplicating
Description: When wielded, this weapon duplicates itself. It can only create 1 copy.

Name: Sandman
Description: On a critical hit, this weapon puts the target to sleep for 7 turns. If it takes more than 10 damage, the target will wake prematurely.

Name: Acid
Description: Attacks with this weapon throw acid at the target, removing 1 Armor.

Name: Attitude
Description: Targets hit by this weapon have -6 Will against Persuasion rolls. This does not stack.

Name: Cauterize
Description: Any healing on targets hit with this weapon are -3 for 3 turns. This does not stack.

Name: Fire
Description: Attacks with this weapon deal an extra 1d12 fire damage to the target. The wielder also rolls 1d6, and on a 6, sets the target aflame to take 1d6 damage each turn.

Name: Flaying
Description: This weapon deals an extra die of damage against targets wearing no armor.

Name: Frost
Description: Attacks with this weapon deal an extra 1d4 frost damage to the target and slows them by 2 actions for 3 turns. This does not stack.

Name: Knockback
Description: Attacks with this weapon push the target away 3 spaces.

Name: Lightning
Description: Attacks with this weapon deal an extra 1d10 lightning damage to the target. If their Armor is 7+, this damage is tripled.

Name: Sonic
Description: Attacks with this weapon, successful or not, deal an extra 1d4 sonic damage to the target, bypassing armor. They are Muted and Deafened for 1 turn.

Name: Contracted
Description: This weapon loses 1 die of damage to become smaller. A 2H becomes a 1H, or a 1H gains a +7 Attack bonus.

Name: Dismemberment
Description: Critical hits with this weapon automatically sever one of the target’s limbs.

Name: Expanded
Description: This weapon becomes bigger to gain 1 die of damage. A 1H becomes a 2H, or a 2H takes a -7 Attack penalty.

Name: Magistrike
Description: This weapon is imbued with a hovering orb that assists in attacks. Each attack (successful or not) comes with a Magic Missile at the wielder’s level.

Name: Radiance
Description: This weapon glows brightly, providing light up to 7 spaces away, and also deals double damage to undead and demons.

Name: Recoil
Description: The wielder can choose for an attack with this weapon to cause a recoil, knocking back both them and their target 4 spaces. If either crash into anything, they’ll take appropriate impact damage.

Name: Silent
Description: Neither this weapon nor its target will make noise on a successful attack. Its Attacker may stay in Stealth.

Name: Accurate
Description: Attacks with this weapon take the higher of 2d20 rolls.

Name: Curative
Description: Once a day, this weapon can heal an ally or harm a Undead/Demon target for 2d6 HP/Damage for 1 action.

Name: Dispel
Description: Attacks with this weapon remove 1 magical effect from the target, prioritizing positive effects.

Name: Lifedrinker
Description: Attacks with this weapon heal the wielder for ¼ the damage dealt.

Name: Bane
Description: This weapon has the Favored Enemy feat (Choose an enemy from Favored Enemies list).

Name: Overcoming
Description: Each successful attack with this weapon increases the wielder’s Attacks against that target by +2.

Name: Quantum Shot
Description: Unsuccessful attacks with this ranged weapon will hit the closest enemy to the target.

Name: Wrecker
Description: Before each attack, the wielder may choose to sacrifice accuracy for this weapon to bypass its target’s Armor. For every 2 Attack sacrificed, the attack will bypass 1 Armor.

Name: Anarchic
Description: This weapon deals double damage against Lawful and Construct targets.

Name: Aperture
Description: This weapon adds an extra die of damage if its target’s HP is above 60.

Name: Exploding
Description: Attacks with this weapon deal half damage to everyone adjacent to the target, including the wielder (if melee).

Name: Return
Description: If the wielder is not holding this weapon, they may use 1 action to bring it zooming back into their hand.

Name: Righteous
Description: This weapon deals an extra die of damage against Evil, Undead, and Demons. It also prevents its own damage against anyone its wielder chooses.

Name: Slaying
Description: If an attack with this weapon brings your target to 10 HP or less, it instantly kills them.

Name: Breaching
Description: This weapon ignores the effects of shields and has +5 Athletics when knocking down doors, walls, and other barriers.

Name: Failsafe
Description: If an attack with this weapon rolls a Natural 1, no extra effect is incurred.

Name: Opening
Description: This weapon surpasses all mechanical locks. Attacks with it also reduce the target's Armor by 1.

Name: Paired
Description: For use on 2 weapons. These weapons become bonded, gaining extra magical effects when wielded together. Effects depend on the weapons chosen, but are greater the more similar the weapons are.

Name: Possession
Description: This weapon can only be picked up and held by the wielder.

Name: Spell Drain
Description: Attacks with this weapon expend one of the target’s spells before they can use it.

Name: Infernal Wound
Description: Attacks with this weapon reduce the target’s maximum HP by 2.

Name: Dervish
Description: This weapon can fly and attack on its own. 1H weapons move 2 spaces per action, 2H weapons move 1 space per action.

Name: Constricting
Description: Upon a successful attack, the wielder can choose for this weapon to constrict the target, preventing Move actions and dealing 1 damage (bypassing Armor) each turn. The weapon cannot be used for anything else during this time.

Name: Mimetic
Description: The wielder may turn this weapon into any other weapon for 5 turns for 1 action. Usage of this weapon is still dependent on the wielder’s skills.

Name: Ability Trickster
Description: Basic Attacks with this weapon use a different Attack of your choice.

Name: Buoyant
Description: This weapon or armor will float on liquid, no matter its material.

Name: Stoneset
Description: The wielder may set this weapon or armor into a natural surface, whereupon it can only be removed by those who meet the wielder’s criteria.

Name: Sorcery
Description: This weapon or armor grants its wielder +3 Arcana.

Name: Homefinding
Description: This weapon or armor will guide its wielder to the location that they chose upon enchantment.

Name: Speed
Description: This weapon or armor allows its wielder to run 2 spaces per Move action. Does not affect swim/jump/climb speed.

Name: Spell Extending
Description: Any spells cast by the wielder of this weapon or armor last 1 more turn.

Name: Spell Heightening
Description: Any spells cast by the wielder of this weapon or armor deal an extra 1 die of damage, or heal an extra 1 die of HP.

Name: Sublime Bane
Description: This weapon or armor gives its wielder +2 to all Attacks and Defenses against anyone who rolled a higher initiative.

Name: Chorus
Description: The wielder of this weapon or armor may have it record speech and sound, and to play back these recordings on whatever conditions they so choose.

Name: Unseen
Description: This weapon or armor is invisible.

Name: Answerer
Description: This weapon or armor forces an adjacent target to speak the truth.

Name: Corrosion Nix
Description: This weapon or armor is immune to acid and rust effects.

Name: Rapid Casting
Description: Upon enchantment, the user of this weapon or armor must choose a school of magic. All spells that the user casts within this school has an action cost of -1, down to a minimum of 1.

Name: Mastery
Description: Any skill or action penalties the wielder suffers from using this weapon or armor are minimized to -1.

Name: Weightless
Description: This weapon or armor is weightless, halving their requirements.

Name: Intelligent
Description: This weapon or armor has a mind and a voice, and will constantly use both.
